patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography dominates the visual space, often serving as background for text overlays and product displays.
A split-screen hero layout is used on the homepage, dividing the viewport into two distinct, equally weighted content areas for primary categories.
Consistent use of a single sans-serif typeface across all text elements, with variations primarily in size and weight, and frequent use of uppercase for navigational and categorical labels.

A high-contrast monochrome base palette (black and white) is consistently applied to text and background elements, allowing the rich, natural tones of the photography to provide the primary color accents.
Hero section text overlays exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than their background images, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
The main navigation bar at the top of the page remains fixed to the viewport, providing persistent access as the user scrolls.
The footer is a multi-column, dark-themed section providing extensive navigational links and legal information, contrasting with the lighter main content.

technique_notes: Full-bleed imagery is used extensively, often with text overlays, to create immersive hero and section introductions.
A sticky header is implemented to keep the main navigation visible at all times.

Scroll-triggered parallax is applied to hero text elements, causing them to move at a slower rate than their background images, enhancing depth perception. This effect can be achieved using CSS transforms or JavaScript libraries like GSAP for precise control over scroll-linked animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, clean, and airy headings (~3-4x body) paired with smaller, legible body and navigational text, often in uppercase.
design_tokens.spacing: airy and spacious, particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, contributing to a minimalist and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site stands out with its bold, full-bleed editorial photography that acts as the primary visual content, combined with a minimalist UI and subtle parallax effects on hero text. This creates an immersive, high-fashion magazine aesthetic rather than a typical e-commerce grid.
